1: Kamaal aur azmat ki sifaat par aur zaahiri aur baatini naimaton par taarif sirf Allah hi ke liye hai, jis ne apne bande aur Rasool par Quran utara, aur is Quran mein koi tedhapan aur haqq se koi hatna nahin rakha.
2: Balke Us ne use seedha banaya, jis mein koi tazaad aur koi farq nahin, taake woh haqq ko jhutlane walon ko us sakht azaab se daraaye jo Allah ki taraf se un ka muntazir hai, aur un mominon ko jo neik kaam karte hain aisi khabar de jo unhein khush kar de: ke un ke liye ek achha ajr hai jis ke barabar koi doosra ajr nahin.
3: Woh is ajr mein hamesha rahenge, aur yeh un se kabhi nahin kaata jayega.
4: Aur yeh un Yahood, Nasara aur un kuch mushrikon ko daraata hai jinhon ne kaha: Allah ne beta bana liya.
5: In jhoot ghadne walon ko apne is daawe ka koi ilm nahin ke Allah ka koi beta hai, aur na un ke bap-dada ko, jin ki unhon ne is baare mein pairvi ki, koi ilm tha. Yeh baat, jo bina kisi samajh ke un ke munh se nikal gayi, bahut sangeen hai. Woh sirf ek aisa jhoot bolte hain jis ki na koi buniyaad hai aur na koi sahara.
6: Phir aey Rasool, ho sakta hai ke aap gam aur afsos mein apne aap ko halak kar baithein agar woh is Quran par iman na laayein. Magar aisa na kijiye, kyunke unhein hidayat dena aap ki zimmedaari nahin; aap ki zimmedaari sirf paigham pahunchana hai.
7: Be-shak Maine is zameen par maujood makhlooq ko us ke liye ek zeenat banaya, taake Main unhein aazmaoon ke un mein se kaun sab se achhe kaam karta hai jo Allah ko pasand hain aur kaun sab se bure kaam karta hai, taake Main har ek ko wahi badla doon jis ka woh haqdaar hai.
8: Aur Main is zameen par maujood makhlooq ko aisi mitti bana dene wala hoon jis par koi sabza na hoga, aur yeh us waqt hoga jab zameen ki makhlooq ki muddat poori ho jayegi. Lihaza unhein is se nasihat leni chahiye.
9: Aey Rasool, yeh na samjhiye ke Ashab-e-Kahf ka qissa aur woh takhti jis par un ke naam likhe the, Hamari anokhi nishaniyon mein se hain. Haqeeqat mein Hamari doosri nishaniyan, jaise aasmaano aur zameen ko paida karna, is se kahin zyada anokhi hain.
10: Aey Rasool, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab un momin naujawanon ne ghaar mein panaah li, apna deen bachate hue bhaag kar. Phir unhon ne apne Rubb se dua karte hue kaha: aey hamare Rubb, humein apni taraf se rehmat ata farma, hamare gunah maaf karke aur humein hamare dushmanon se bacha kar, aur hamare liye seedhe raaste ki hidayat aur kafiron se hijrat aur iman ke maamle mein durusti ata farma.
11: Phir jab woh gaye aur ghaar mein panaah li, to Maine un ke kaanon par sunne se ek parda daal diya, aur unhein bahut saalon ke liye sula diya.
12: Phir un ki lambi neend ke baad Maine unhein jagaya taake zaahir ho jaye ke un ke ghaar mein rehne ki muddat ke baare mein jhagadne wale dono giroh mein se kaun is muddat ko behtar jaanta hai.
13: Aey Rasool, Main aap ko un ka qissa sach ke saath bata raha hoon, jis mein koi shak nahin. Be-shak woh naujawan the jo apne Rubb par iman laaye aur Us ki itaat ki, aur Maine unhein hidayat aur haqq par sabit-qadmi mein barha diya.
14: Aur Maine un ke dilon ko iman se aur us par jame rehne se mazboot kiya, aur is par ke woh us ke liye apna watan chhodne mein sabr karein, jab woh kafir badshah ke saamne khade ho kar yeh elaan karne lage ke woh sirf Allah par iman rakhte hain, aur unhon ne kaha: jis Rubb par main iman rakhta hoon aur jis ki ibadat karta hoon, Wohi aasmaano aur zameen ka Rubb hai. Main un maaboodon ki kabhi ibadat nahin karoonga jin ka tum ne Us ke siwa jhoota daawa kiya hai. Agar main Us ke siwa doosron ki ibadat karoon to maine ek na-insaaf aur haqq se bahut door baat kahi.
15: Phir woh ek doosre ki taraf mutawajjeh hue aur kehne lage: yeh hamari qaum hai jis ne Allah ke siwa aise maabood bana liye jin ki woh ibadat karti hai. Un ki ibadat ke liye un ke paas koi khuli daleel nahin, lihaza us shaks se bada zaalim koi nahin jo Allah par jhoot ghad kar Us ka koi sharik thehra de.
16: Aur ab jab tum apni qaum se alag ho gaye ho, aur tum ne woh sab chhod diya jis ki woh Allah ke siwa ibadat karte hain, aur tum ne sirf Allah ki ibadat ki, to apna deen bachate hue bhaag kar ghaar mein panaah le lo. Allah, paak hai Woh, tum par apni rehmat phailayega taake tumhein tumhare dushmanon se bachaye, aur tumhare liye guzara aasan kar dega jis se tum faida utha sako, us zindagi ki jagah jo tumhein apni qaum ke darmiyan rehte hue mili thi.
17: Chunanche unhon ne hukm poora kiya aur Allah ne unhein sula diya aur unhein un ke dushman se bacha liya. Aey dekhne wale, tum dekhoge ke sooraj jab mashriq se nikalta hai to un ke ghaar se daayein taraf, us ke liye jo andar daakhil ho, hat jata hai; aur doobte waqt woh ghaar se baayein taraf hat jata hai aur us par seedha nahin padta. Chunanche woh hamesha saye mein hain aur sooraj ki garmi un par asar nahin karti. Aur woh ghaar ke andar ek kushaada jagah mein hain jahan unhein zaroorat ki hawa pahunchti hai. Yeh sab baatein, yani un ka ghaar mein panaah lena, un ka sula diya jana, sooraj ka un se hat jana, ghaar ki kushaadgi aur un ki apni qaum se nijaat, Allah ke anokhe kaam hain jo Us ki qudrat batate hain. Jise Allah hidayat ke raaste ki rehnumai de, wahi shaks haqeeqat mein hidayat par hai. Aur jise Allah chhod de aur gumraah hone de, to aap kabhi koi nahin paayenge jo us ki madad kare aur use seedhe raaste ki hidayat de. Yeh is liye ke hidayat Allah ke haath mein hai, us ke apne haath mein nahin.
18: Aey dekhne wale, tum samjhoge ke woh jaag rahe hain, kyunke un ki aankhein khuli hain, halanke haqeeqat mein woh so rahe hain. Aur Main unhein un ki neend mein karwat badalta hoon, kabhi daayein aur kabhi baayein, taake zameen un ke jism na kha jaye. Aur un ka kutta jo un ke saath tha, ghaar ke munh par apne aage ke paon phailaye hue hai. Agar tum un ke saamne aa jate aur unhein dekh lete, to tum munh moad kar bhaag khade hote aur un se darr jate, aur tumhara dil un ke khauf se bhar jata.
19: Aur jis tarah Maine un ke saath yeh anokhe kaam kiye jin ka Maine zikr kiya, usi tarah Maine unhein ek lambi muddat ke baad jagaya aur woh ek doosre se us muddat ke baare mein poochne lage jo unhon ne sote hue guzari. Un mein se ek ne jawab diya: main ek din ya din ka kuch hissa sota raha. Un mein se ek ne, jis par wazeh nahin hua ke unhon ne kitni muddat sote hue guzari, jawab diya: tumhara Rubb khoob jaanta hai ke tum kitni muddat sote rahe, lihaza is ka ilm Usi ke hawale karo aur us kaam mein lago jo tumhara kaam hai. Tum mein se kisi ko yeh chaandi ke sikke de kar us shehar bhejo jise hum jaante hain, aur woh dekhe ke us shehar ke rehne walon mein se kis ka khana aur kis ki kamayi sab se paak hai. Aur daakhil hote, nikalte aur len-den karte waqt woh ehtiyaat se kaam le. Aur use hoshyaar rehna chahiye aur kisi ko pata na chalne de ke tum kahan ho, kyunke is ka natija bada nuqsan hoga.
20: Agar tumhari qaum tumhein paa le aur un ko tumhara thikana maaloom ho jaye, to woh tumhein paththar maar kar qatl kar denge, ya tumhein majboor karenge ke tum un ke us bigde hue deen ki taraf laut aao jis par tum pehle the, is se pehle ke Allah ne tum par ehsan kiya aur tumhein sachche deen ki hidayat di. Aur agar tum us ki taraf laut gaye to tum kabhi kaamyab nahin hoge, na duniya mein aur na Aakhirat mein. Balke tum dono jaghon par bada ghaata uthaoge, is wajah se ke tum ne woh sachcha deen chhod diya jis ki Allah ne tumhein hidayat di aur us bigde hue deen ki taraf laut aaye.
21: Aur jis tarah Maine woh anokhe kaam kiye, yani unhein sulana aur bahut saalon ke baad jagana, jo Meri qudrat batate hain, usi tarah Maine un ke shehar walon ko un par mutla kar diya, taake woh log jaan lein ke Allah ka mominon ki madad ka wada aur dobara zinda hone ka wada sach hai, aur yeh ke Qayamat be-shak aane wali hai. Phir jab Ashab-e-Kahf ka maamla khul gaya aur woh wafat paa gaye, to jin logon ne unhein paaya unhon ne ikhtilaaf kiya: un ke saath kya kiya jaye? Ek giroh ne kaha: ghaar ke munh par ek imarat bana do jo aad bane aur unhein mehfooz rakhe. Un ka Rubb un ke haal ko khoob jaanta hai aur un ke haal ka taqaza yeh hai ke Us ke nazdeek un ka koi khaas muqaam hai. Aur un asar wale logon ne, jin ke paas na ilm tha aur na koi durust daawat, kaha: main un ke oopar un ki izzat mein aur un ki jagah ki yaadgaar ke taur par ek ibadat-gah banaoonga.
22: Un ke waqiye mein gehrayi mein jaane wale kuch log un ki tadaad ke baare mein kahenge: woh teen the aur un ka kutta un mein chautha tha. Doosre kahenge: woh paanch the aur un ka kutta un mein chhata tha. Dono giroh ne yeh sirf gumaan se kaha, bina kisi daleel ke. Aur kuch kahenge: woh saat the aur un ka kutta un mein aathwan tha. Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: aap ka Rubb un ki tadaad ko khoob jaanta hai. Un ki tadaad chand logon ke siwa koi nahin jaanta jinhein Allah ne un ki tadaad batayi. Lihaza un ki tadaad ya un ke kisi aur maamle ke baare mein ahl-e-kitab se ya doosron se jhagda na kijiye, siwaye ek khuli daleel ke, aur us maamle ki gehrayi mein na jaiye, use usi wahi tak mehdood rakhiye jo un ke baare mein aap par utari. Aur un mein se kisi se un ke maamle ki tafseel na poochiye, kyunke woh us ke baare mein kuch nahin jaante.
23: Aey Nabi, kisi aise kaam ke baare mein jo aap kal karna chahte hain yeh na kahiye: 'Main yeh kaam kal karoonga,' kyunke aap nahin jaante ke aap use karenge ya aap use karne se rok diye jayenge. Aur yeh hukm har musalman ke liye hai.
24: Siwaye is ke ke aap use Allah ki marzi par chhod dein aur kahein: main yeh kaam karoonga, agar Allah ne chaaha, kal. Aur agar aap 'in sha Allah' kehna bhool jayein to use keh kar apne Rubb ko yaad kijiye, aur kahiye: mujhe umeed hai ke mera Rubb mujhe is se bhi zyada qareeb hidayat aur kaamyabi ki taraf rehnumai karega.
25: Aur Ashab-e-Kahf apne ghaar mein teen sau nau saal rahe.
26: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: Allah khoob jaanta hai ke woh ghaar mein kitni muddat rahe, aur Us ne humein woh muddat bata di jo woh wahan rahe. Allah ki baat ke baad, paak hai Woh, kisi ki baat ka koi aitbaar nahin. Aasmaano aur zameen ki har chhipi cheez sirf Usi ki hai, paak hai Woh. Usi ne un sab ko paida kiya aur Wohi un sab ko jaanta hai. Woh kitna khoob dekhta hai! Paak hai Woh! Woh har cheez dekhta hai. Aur Woh kitna khoob sunta hai! Woh har cheez sunta hai. Us ke siwa un ka koi nahin jo un ka maamla sambhaale. Woh apni baadshahat mein kisi ko sharik nahin karta. Wohi yakta faisla karta hai.
27: Aey Rasool, us Quran ko padhiye aur us par amal kijiye jo Allah ne aap par utara. Us ke kalmon ko koi badal nahin sakta, kyunke woh poori tarah sachche aur insaaf wale hain. Aur aap Us ke siwa koi panaah nahin paayenge jis ki taraf jayein aur na koi bachne ki jagah jis mein chhip sakein.
28: Apne un gareeb sathiyon ke saath rahiye aur un se qareeb rahiye jo din ke shuru aur din ke aakhir mein khulus ke saath apne Rubb ko ibadat aur dua mein pukarte hain. Aur apni nazarein un se na hataiye is irade se ke aap maaldaar aur bade logon ke saath bethein. Aur us shaks ke peeche na chaliye jis ke dil ko Maine mohar laga kar Hamari yaad se gaafil kar diya aur jis ne aap se kaha ke gareebon ko apni majlis se nikaal dein, apne Rubb ki itaat par apni khwahish ki pairvi ko tarjeeh dete hue. Chunanche us ke kaam aur us ke aamaal nadani, hadd se barhna aur be-kaar hain.
29: Aey Rasool, un logon se keh dijiye jo apne dilon ki gaflat ki wajah se Allah ki yaad se gaafil hain: jo kuch main tumhare paas laaya hoon woh haqq hai. Woh Allah ki taraf se hai, meri taraf se nahin. Aur main tumhari yeh baat nahin maan sakta ke mominon ko bhaga doon. Tum mein se jo is haqq par iman laana chahe woh laa le, kyunke use us ka ajr khush karega. Aur tum mein se jo use jhutlana chahe woh jhutla de, kyunke use woh azaab gamgeen karega jo us ka muntazir hai. Maine un logon ke liye jo kufr chun kar apni jaanon par zulm karte hain, ek bari aag tayyar kar rakhi hai jis ki deewarein unhein gher lengi aur is wajah se woh us se nikal nahin sakenge. Aur agar woh apni shadeed pyaas ki wajah se paani se rahat chaahein, to unhein aisa paani diya jayega jo gaadhe tel jaisa hoga, nihayat garam hoga aur apni garmi se un ke chehre jhulsa dega. Rahat ke liye diya jaane wala yeh peene ki cheez kitni buri hai! Woh na un ki pyaas bujhayegi aur na un ke chehre jalaane wale shole bujhayegi. Aur Aag kitna bura thikana aur kitni buri rehne ki jagah hai!
30: Jo log Allah par iman laate hain aur neik kaam karte hain, unhon ne ehsan kiya aur unhein bada ajr milega. Main ehsan karne walon ka ajr zaaya nahin karta. Balke Main unhein un ka ajr poora deta hoon, bina kisi kami ke.
31: Jin logon ki sifat yeh hai ke woh iman rakhte hain aur neik kaam karte hain, unhein rehne ke liye baagh milenge, jin ke gharon ke neeche Jannat ki meethi nahrein behti hongi. Unhein sone ke kangan pehnaye jayenge aur woh barik aur dabeez resham ke sabz kapde pehnenge. Woh aise takhton par takiya lagaye bethe honge jo khoobsurat gilaafon se saje honge. Un ka ajr kitna umda hai aur Jannat un ke liye kitna achha ghar aur kitni achhi rehne ki jagah hai!
32: Aey Rasool, do mardon ki misaal bayan kijiye: ek kafir aur ek momin. Maine kafir ko do baagh diye jinhein Maine khajoor ke darakhton se gher diya; aur un ke darmiyan khaali zameen mein Maine kheti ugaayi.
33: Har baagh ne apna phal diya, yani khajoor, angoor aur kheti, aur us mein koi kami nahin ki balke poora phal diya. Aur Maine dono baagon ke darmiyan ek nahar chala di taake unhein aasani se paani mile.
34: Aur dono baagon ke maalik ke paas aur maal aur aur phal bhi the, aur us ne apne saathi se kaha, us se gurur ke saath baat karte hue taake us par asar daale: 'Mere paas tujh se zyada maal hai, zyada sahara hai aur zyada mazboot khaandan hai.'
35: Aur woh kafir apne baagh mein us momin ke saath daakhil hua taake use dikhaye, jab ke woh apne kufr aur apne gurur se apni jaan par zulm kar raha tha. Us kafir ne kaha: main nahin samajhta ke yeh baagh jo tu dekh raha hai kabhi mitega, kyunke maine is ke baaqi rehne ke liye har tadbeer kar li hai.
36: Aur main yeh bhi nahin samajhta ke Qayamat aayegi. Zindagi bas yoon hi chalti rahegi. Aur agar woh aa bhi gayi aur main dobara zinda kar diya gaya aur apne Rubb ki taraf lautaya gaya, to main paaoonga ke dobara zinda hone ke baad jahan main jaoonga woh is baagh se behtar hoga. Duniya mein mera maaldaar hona is ka matlab hai ke main dobara zinda hone ke baad bhi maaldaar hi rahunga.
37: Us ke momin saathi ne is guftagu ke dauran us se kaha: kya tu us ka inkaar karta hai jis ne tere baap Adam (alaihis salaam) ko mitti se paida kiya? Phir Us ne tujhe nutfe se paida kiya. Phir Us ne tujhe ek mard insaan banaya aur tere aazaa theek kar ke tujhe poora kiya. Jo yeh sab karne par qaadir hai, Woh tujhe dobara zinda karne par bhi qaadir hai.
38: Magar main teri yeh baat nahin maanta. Main to bas yeh kehta hoon: Wohi Allah, paak hai Woh, mera Rubb hai, jis ne hum par apni naimatein barsayin, aur main ibadat mein Us ka koi sharik nahin thehrata.
39: Aur kaash, jab tu apne baagh mein daakhil hua, tu ne kaha hota: jaisa Allah chahe. Allah ke siwa kisi ke paas koi zor nahin. Wohi hai jo apni marzi se karta hai aur Wohi taaqat wala hai. Agar tu mujhe apne se kam maal aur kam aulaad wala samajhta hai,
40: To mujhe umeed hai ke Allah mujhe tere baagh se behtar cheez dega aur tere baagh par aasman se koi azaab bhejega, jis se woh ek banjar tukda ban jayega jis par paon phisal jayenge, is ki chiknaahat ki wajah se.
41: Ya us ka paani zameen mein itna gehra utar jayega ke tu use kisi tarah bhi dobara nahin paa sakega. Aur jab paani gehra utar jaye to baagh baaqi nahin rehta.
42: Aur jo kuch us momin ne kaha tha wahi hua. Us kafir ke baagh ke phal par barbaadi aa gayi aur woh kafir shadeed afsos aur pachhtawe mein apne haath malne laga, us maal par jo us ne us ki dekh-bhaal aur us ki maramat par kharch kiya tha, jab ke baagh un tattiyon par gir pada tha jin par angoor ki belein phailayi jati hain, aur woh keh raha tha: kaash maine sirf apne Rubb par iman rakha hota aur ibadat mein Us ka koi sharik na thehraya hota.
43: Aur us kafir ka koi giroh na tha jo use us azaab se bachaye jo us par aaya, halanke wahi apne giroh par fakhr kiya karta tha. Aur woh khud bhi Allah ko apna baagh tabah karne se na rok saka.
44: Us haal mein fatah sirf Allah ki hai. Wohi, paak hai Woh, apne un doston ko, jo iman rakhte hain, sab se behtar ajr deta hai, kyunke Woh un ke liye ajr kai guna barha deta hai, aur Wohi un ke liye sab se behtar anjaam deta hai.
45: Aey Rasool, un logon ke liye ek misaal bayan kijiye jo duniya ke dhoke mein hain. Duniya apne waqti aur guzar jaane wale hone mein us baarish ke paani jaisi hai jo Maine aasman se utara. Us paani se zameen ka sabza uga aur pak gaya. Phir woh sabza tukde tukde ho gaya aur hawa use door door tak uda le gayi, aur zameen phir waisi hi ho gayi jaisi pehle thi. Aur Allah is sab par poori qudrat rakhta hai. Koi cheez Us ki qudrat se bahar nahin. Woh jise chahe zindagi deta hai aur jise chahe mita deta hai.
46: Maal aur aulaad duniya ki is zindagi ki zeenat hain. Maal Aakhirat mein sirf us waqt faida dega jab use us cheez par kharch kiya jaye jo Allah ko pasand hai. Aur woh aamaal aur woh baatein jo Allah ko pasand hain, ajr mein duniya ki har zeenat se behtar hain. Aur yahi woh cheez hai jis ki aadmi sab se zyada umeed rakh sakta hai, kyunke duniya ki zeenat mit jayegi jab ke un aamaal aur un baaton ka ajr jo Allah ko pasand hain baaqi rahega.
47: Aur woh din yaad karo jab Main pahaadon ko un ki jaghon se hata doonga, aur tum zameen ko ek khula maidan dekhoge, kyunke us par maujood tamam pahaad, darakht aur imaratein khatam ho chuki hongi. Aur Main tamam makhlooq ko jama karoonga aur unhein dobara zinda karoonga, kisi ko nahin chhodoonga.
48: Aur log aap ke Rubb ke saamne safon mein pesh kiye jayenge aur Woh un ka hisaab lega. Un se kaha jayega: ab tum Hamare paas akele akele aa gaye, nange paon aur nange badan, jaise Maine tumhein pehli baar paida kiya tha. Halanke tum daawa karte the ke tum kabhi dobara zinda nahin kiye jaoge aur yeh ke Main tumhare liye koi aisa waqt aur koi aisi jagah muqarrar nahin karoonga jis mein Main tumhein tumhare aamaal ka badla doon.
49: Aur aamaal ki kitab rakh di jayegi. Kuch log apni kitab apne daayein haath mein lenge aur kuch apne baayein haath mein. Aur aey insaan, tum kafiron ko us ke mazmoon se darte hue dekhoge, kyunke woh us kufr aur un gunahon se waaqif hain jo unhon ne aage bheje. Woh kahenge: haaye hamari barbaadi! Is kitab ko kya ho gaya ke yeh hamara koi amal nahin chhodti, chhota ho ya bada, magar use likh aur gin kar rakhti hai? Aur woh apne tamam gunah, jo unhon ne duniya ki zindagi mein kiye, likhe aur darj paayenge. Aur aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb kisi par zulm nahin karta. Woh kisi ko bina wajah saza nahin deta aur un logon ka ajr kam nahin karta jo Us ki itaat karte hain.
50: Aey Rasool, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab Maine farishton se kaha: Adam (alaihis salaam) ko izzat ka sajda karo. To un sab ne apne Rubb ka hukm poora karte hue unhein sajda kiya, siwaye Iblis ke. Woh jinnon mein se tha, farishta nahin tha. Us ne inkaar kiya aur gurur mein aa kar sajda na kiya. Is tarah woh apne Rubb ki itaat se nikal gaya. Phir aey logo, kya tum use aur us ki aulaad ko Mujhe chhod kar apna dost banate ho jin se tum mel rakho, jab ke woh tumhare dushman hain? Tum apne dushmanon ko apna dost kaise bana lete ho? Un zaalimon ka yeh kaam kitna bura aur kitna ganda hai jo Allah se dosti ke bajaye shaytan ko apna dost banate hain!
51: Jinhein tum ne Mujhe chhod kar apna dost bana rakha hai, woh sab tum hi jaise bande hain. Maine unhein aasmaano aur zameen ki takhleeq ke waqt haazir nahin kiya jab Maine unhein paida kiya. Balke woh us waqt maujood hi nahin the. Aur Maine un mein se kisi ko doosron ki takhleeq par bhi haazir nahin kiya. Main takhleeq aur intezam mein yakta hoon. Aur Main un insaan aur jinn shaytanon ko apna madadgaar nahin banata jo doosron ko gumraah karte hain, kyunke Main kisi madadgaar ka mohtaaj nahin.
52: Aey Rasool, unhein Qayamat ka woh din yaad dilaiye jab Allah un logon se kahega jinhon ne duniya mein Us ke saath doosron ko sharik thehraya: Mere un sharikon ko pukaro jinhein tum Mera sharik kehte the, taake woh tumhari madad karein. Woh unhein pukarenge, magar woh un ki pukar ka jawab nahin denge aur un ki madad ko nahin aayenge. Aur Main poojne walon aur jinhein woh poojte the un ke darmiyan ek halakat ka garha rakh doonga, jo dono giroh ke liye hoga, aur woh Jahannam ki aag hai.
53: Aur mushrik Aag ko dekhenge aur unhein poora yaqeen ho jayega ke woh us mein girne wale hain. Aur woh us se bhaagne ke liye koi jagah nahin paayenge.
54: Aur Maine is Quran mein, jo Muhammad ﷺ par utara gaya, tarah tarah se bahut si misaalein khol kar bayan kein taake woh sabaq lein aur dhyaan dein. Magar insaan mein, khaas kar kafir mein, jo cheez sab se zyada zaahir hai woh na-haqq jhagadna hai.
55: Aur hath-dharam kafiron ko us baat par iman laane se jo Muhammad ﷺ apne Rubb ki taraf se laaye kisi cheez ne nahin roka. Unhein apne gunahon ki Allah se magfirat maangne se wazahat ki kami ne nahin roka, kyunke un ke saamne Quran mein bahut si misaalein di gayin aur un ke paas khuli dalilein aayin. Unhein sirf is baat ne roka ke woh hath-dharmi se yeh maangte rahe ke un par pichli ummaton ka azaab utar aaye aur woh us azaab ko dekh lein jis ka un se wada kiya gaya.
56: Aur Main apne rasoolon ko sirf is liye bhejta hoon ke iman aur itaat walon ko khush-khabri dein aur kufr aur nafarmani walon ko daraayein. Un ke paas yeh ikhtiyar nahin ke dilon se hidayat qabool karwa dein. Aur jin logon ne Allah ka inkaar kiya woh khuli dalilon ke baawajood rasoolon se jhagadte hain, is koshish mein ke apne baatil se us haqq ko mita dein jo Muhammad ﷺ par utara. Aur unhon ne Quran ko aur us cheez ko jis se unhein daraya gaya, mazaaq aur thathol bana liya.
57: Aur us shaks se bada zaalim koi nahin jise us ke Rubb ki aayatein yaad dilayi gayin magar us ne un mein maujood azaab ki tambeeh par koi dhyaan na diya aur sabaq lene se munh mod liya, aur apne woh kufr aur woh gunah bhool gaya jo us ne apni duniya ki zindagi mein kiye aur un se tauba na ki. Maine in sifaat wale logon ke dilon par aise parde daal diye jo unhein Quran samajhne se rokte hain, aur un ke kaanon mein behra-pan daal diya taake woh use maan kar na sunein. Aur agar aap unhein iman ki taraf bulayein to woh kabhi aap ki daawat ka jawab nahin denge jab tak un ke dilon par parde aur un ke kaanon mein behra-pan hai.
58: Aur taake Nabi ﷺ apne jhutlane walon ke liye jald azaab ke muntazir na rahein, Allah ne un se farmaya: aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb un logon ke gunah bakshne wala hai jo tauba karte hain, aur Us ki rehmat ne har cheez ko gher rakha hai. Aur Us ki rehmat hi se Woh gunahgaron ko mohlat deta hai taake woh Us ki taraf tauba karein. Agar Woh in munh modne walon ko saza deta, to Woh un ke liye duniya hi mein azaab jald kar deta. Magar Woh Burdbaar aur Meharban hai. Us ne azaab is liye tal diya ke woh tauba karein. Aur un ke liye ek muqarrar waqt aur ek muqarrar jagah hai jis mein unhein un ke kufr aur un ke munh modne ka badla milega agar woh tauba na karein, aur us se woh koi bachne ki jagah nahin paayenge.
59: Aur aap ke qareeb ki woh kafir bastiyan, jaise Hud (alaihis salaam), Saleh (alaihis salaam) aur Shoaib ki qaumon ki bastiyan: Maine unhein halak kar diya jab unhon ne kufr aur gunahon se apni jaanon par zulm kiya, aur Maine un ki halakat ke liye ek muqarrar waqt rakha tha.
60: Aey Rasool, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apne khadim Yusha bin Noon se kaha: main safar karta rahunga yahan tak ke us jagah pahunch jaoon jahan do samundar milte hain, ya main us waqt tak safar karta rahunga jab tak us neik bande se mil na loon aur us se seekh na loon.
61: Chunanche woh dono chal pade, aur jab us jagah pahunche jahan do samundar milte hain, to woh machhli bhool gaye jo woh khane ke liye saath laaye the. Allah ne us machhli ko zindagi di aur us ne samundar mein surang jaisa raasta bana liya, jis se paani phir nahin mila.
62: Jab woh us jagah se guzar gaye, to Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apne khadim se kaha: hamara khana le aao, is safar mein humein shadeed thakaan hui hai.
63: Us ladke ne kaha: kya aap ko woh yaad hai jo us waqt hua jab hum chattan ke paas thehre the? Main aap ko machhli ke baare mein batana bhool gaya. Mujhe shaytan hi ne bhula diya ke main aap se us ka zikr karta. Woh machhli zinda ho gayi aur us ne ajeeb tareeqe se samundar mein apna raasta bana liya.
64: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apne khadim se kaha: yahi to hum talash kar rahe the, kyunke yahi us neik bande ki jagah ki nishani hai. Chunanche woh apne qadamon ke nishan par wapas mud gaye taake raasta na bhool jayein, yahan tak ke us chattan tak pahunch gaye aur wahan se us jagah tak jahan machhli samundar mein daakhil hui thi.
65: Jab woh us jagah pahunche jahan machhli gum hui thi, to unhon ne wahan Mere neik bandon mein se ek bande ko paaya, yani Khizr (alaihis salaam) ko, jise Maine rehmat di thi aur jise Maine aisa ilm sikhaya tha jis se log waaqif na the, aur wahi is qisse mein bayan hua hai.
66: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne un se aajizi aur adab ke saath kaha: kya main aap ke peeche chal sakta hoon taake aap mujhe us ilm mein se kuch sikhayein jo Allah ne aap ko sikhaya aur jo haqq ki hidayat hai?
67: Khizr ne kaha: aap mere ilm mein se jo kuch dekhenge us par sabr nahin kar sakenge, kyunke woh aap ke ilm ke mutabiq nahin hoga.
68: Aur aap un kaamon par kaise sabr karenge jo aap dekhenge aur jin ki asal wajah aap nahin jaante, kyunke aap unhein apne ilm ki hadd ke mutabiq parkhenge?
69: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: aap mujhe, agar Allah ne chaaha, apne un kaamon par sabr karne wala paayenge jo main dekhoonga, aur aap ki pairvi par qayam. Main aap ke kisi hukm ke khilaaf nahin jaoonga.
70: Khizr ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) se kaha: agar aap mere peeche chalein, to mujh se kisi aisi cheez ke baare mein na poochein jo aap mujhe karte hue dekhein, jab tak main khud aap ko us ki wajah na bata doon.
71: Jab woh is par raazi ho gaye, to woh samundar ke kinare ki taraf chale aur wahan unhein ek kashti mili, jis par woh bina kiraye ke sawaar hue, Khizr ki izzat mein. Phir Khizr ne us kashti ka ek takhta nikaal kar us mein surakh kar diya. Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne un se kaha: kya aap ne us kashti mein surakh kar diya jis ke maalikon ne humein bina kiraye ke sawaar kiya, is umeed par ke woh doob jayein? Aap ne ek uljhan mein daalne wala aur hairan karne wala kaam kiya.
72: Khizr ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) se kaha: kya maine kaha nahin tha ke aap mere kaamon par, jo aap dekhenge, sabr nahin kar sakenge?
73: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne Khizr se kaha: mujhe apna ahd bhool jaane par na pakdiye aur mere liye apne saath rehna mushkil aur sakht na banaiye.
74: Phir jab woh kashti se utre to woh samundar ke kinare par chalte rahe, yahan tak ke unhein ek ladka dikha jo abhi baaligh nahin hua tha aur doosre ladkon ke saath khel raha tha. Khizr ne use maar daala, aur Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne un se kaha: kya aap ne ek paak jaan ko, jo abhi chhoti hai, bina kisi gunah ke qatl kar diya? Aap ne waqai ek bahut bura kaam kiya!
75: Khizr ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) se kaha: 'Maine aap se kaha tha: aey Moosa, aap mere is kaam par kabhi sabr nahin kar sakenge.'
76: Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne Khizr se kaha: 'Mujhe doosri baar bhi maaf kar dijiye. Magar agar main is ke baad kisi cheez ke baare mein poochoon, to mujhe chhod dijiye, kyunke aap us hadd tak pahunch jayenge jis par aap ka mera saath chhodna maazoor samjha jayega, kyunke main teen baar aap ke hukm ke khilaaf ja chuka hoonga.'
77: Phir woh chalte rahe yahan tak ke ek basti walon ke paas pahunche aur un se khana maanga, magar basti walon ne unhein khilane aur un ki mehman-nawaazi ka haqq ada karne se inkaar kar diya. Phir unhein us basti mein ek deewar mili jo jhuki hui thi aur girne aur tootne ko thi. Chunanche Khizr ne use theek kiya yahan tak ke woh seedhi ho gayi. To Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne Khizr se kaha: 'Agar aap chahte to is ko theek karne ki ujrat le sakte the, kyunke un ke mehman-nawaazi se inkaar karne ke baad humein is ki zaroorat hai.'
78: Khizr ne Moosa (alaihis salaam) se kaha: 'Deewar khade karne par ujrat na lene par aap ka yeh aitraaz mere aur aap ke darmiyan judaai ka muqaam hai. Main aap ko un kaamon ki wajah bata deta hoon jo aap ne mujhe karte dekha magar jin par aap sabr nahin kar sake.'
79: Jahan tak us kashti ka taalluq hai jise todne par aap ne mujh par aib lagaya, woh kuch kamzor logon ki thi jo samundar par kaam karte the aur jo us ki hifazat nahin kar sakte the. Chunanche maine chaaha ke jo maine us ke saath kiya us se woh aibdar ho jaye, taake use woh badshah na le le jo un ke aage tha aur jo har achhi kashti zabardasti us ke maalikon se chhin leta tha magar har aibdar kashti chhod deta tha.
80: Aur jahan tak us ladke ka taalluq hai jise qatl karne par aap ne mujh par aib lagaya, us ke maa-baap momin the magar woh Allah ke ilm mein kafir tha. Chunanche mujhe dar hua ke agar woh bada ho jata to apni un ki shadeed mohabbat ya un ki apni shadeed zaroorat ki wajah se unhein Allah ka inkaar karne par le jata.
81: Lihaza maine chaaha ke Allah unhein us se behtar bachcha de: deen mein, taqwe mein aur gunahon se paaki mein, aur jo apne maa-baap par zyada meharban ho.
82: Aur jahan tak us deewar ka taalluq hai jise maine theek kiya aur jis par aap ne mujh par aib lagaya, woh us basti ke do chhote ladkon ki thi jahan hum gaye the aur jin ka baap mar chuka tha. Us deewar ke neeche un ka kuch maal dafn tha. Aur in dono ladkon ka baap neik tha. Chunanche aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), aap ke Rubb ne chaaha ke woh samajh ki umar tak pahunchein aur bade ho jayein, aur apna woh maal nikaalein jo us ke neeche dafn tha, kyunke agar deewar ab gir jati to un ka maal khul jata aur zaaya ho jata. Aur yeh tadbeer un par aap ke Rubb ki rehmat thi. Aur maine yeh apni raaye se nahin kiya. Yeh un baaton ki wajah hai jin par aap sabr nahin kar sake.
83: Aur aey Rasool, mushrik aur Yahood aap se Zul-Qarnain ke baare mein poochte hain taake aap ko aazmayein. Keh dijiye: main tumhein un ka kuch qissa sunaata hoon jis se tum sabaq lo aur nasihat paao.
84: Maine unhein zameen mein iqtidar diya aur unhein har us cheez mein se diya jo un ke maqsad se taalluq rakhti thi, ek aisa raasta jis se woh apni manzil tak pahunch sakein.
85: Chunanche unhon ne woh zariye aur woh raaste apnaye jo Maine unhein diye the aur jo un ki manzil tak le jate the, aur phir magrib ki taraf chal pade.
86: Aur woh zameen par chalte rahe yahan tak ke sooraj doobne ki simt mein zameen ke aakhir tak pahunch gaye, aur unhein aisa laga jaise woh kaali keechad wale ek garam chashme mein doob raha ho. Aur unhein sooraj doobne ki jagah par ek kafir qaum mili. Chunanche Maine unhein aazmane ke liye kaha: 'Aey Zul-Qarnain, tum chaho to in logon ko qatl karke ya kisi aur tareeqe se saza do, ya tum un ke saath achha sulook karo.'
87: Zul-Qarnain ne kaha: 'Jahan tak us shaks ka taalluq hai jo Allah ke saath sharik thehrata hai aur is par ada rehta hai, main use is zindagi mein qatl karke saza doonga, phir woh Qayamat ke din apne Rubb ki taraf lautega aur Woh use ek bhayanak azaab dega.'
88: 'Aur jahan tak us shaks ka taalluq hai jo Allah par iman laata hai aur neik kaam karta hai, us ke liye Jannat hai, aap ke Rubb ki taraf se us ke iman aur us ke neik aamaal ka badla. Aur main apne hukm mein us se woh baat kahunga jis mein aasani aur narmi ho.'
89: Phir unhon ne apne pehle raaste se alag ek raasta liya, sooraj nikalne ki simt ki taraf.
90: Aur woh chalte rahe yahan tak ke jab woh us jagah pahunche jahan sooraj nikalta hai, to unhon ne use aise logon par nikalte paaya jinhein Maine na koi ghar diye the aur na darakhton ka saya jo unhein sooraj se bachaye.
91: Yeh Zul-Qarnain ka maamla hai, aur Mere ilm ne us taaqat aur us zor ko gher rakha tha jo un ke paas tha.
92: Phir unhon ne pehle dono se alag ek raasta liya, mashriq aur magrib ke darmiyan phailte hue.
93: Aur woh chalte rahe yahan tak ke do pahaadon ke darmiyan ek darre tak pahunche, aur unhein un ke saamne aise log mile jo doosron ki baat mushkil se hi samajhte the.
94: Unhon ne kaha: 'Aey Zul-Qarnain, Yajuj aur Majuj, yani Adam (alaihis salaam) ki aulaad mein se do bari qaumein, zameen mein qatl waghairah se fasaad macha rahi hain, to kya hum aap ko kuch maal dein taake aap hamare aur un ke darmiyan ek aad bana dein?'
95: Zul-Qarnain ne kaha: 'Jo baadshahat aur jo taaqat mere Rubb ne mujhe di hai woh us har maal se behtar hai jo tum mujhe de sakte ho, lihaza mardon aur auzaron se meri madad karo. Main tumhare aur un ke darmiyan ek aad bana doonga.'
96: 'Lohe ke tukde laao.' Woh un ke paas le aaye, to unhon ne un se dono pahaadon ke darmiyan taameer shuru kar di, yahan tak ke jab unhein apni taameer ke barabar kar liya, to unhon ne kaam karne walon se kaha: 'In tukdon ko aag do,' yahan tak ke jab lohe ke tukde laal ho gaye, to unhon ne kaha: 'Taanba laao taake main us par undel doon.'
97: Chunanche Yajuj aur Majuj na us ki buland hone ki wajah se us par chadh sake aur na us ki sakhti ki wajah se us ke neeche se surakh kar sake.
98: Zul-Qarnain ne kaha: 'Yeh aad mere Rubb ki rehmat hai. Yeh Yajuj aur Majuj aur zameen mein fasaad phailane ke darmiyan aad banegi aur unhein is se rokegi. Phir jab woh waqt aa jayega jo Allah ne Qayamat se pehle un ke chhootne ke liye muqarrar kiya hai, to Woh use zameen ke barabar kar dega. Aur Allah ka use zameen ke barabar karne aur Yajuj aur Majuj ko chhodne ka wada pakka hai aur woh toota nahin karega.'
99: Aur Main Yajuj aur Majuj ko us din, jab yeh aad tootegi, ek doosre mein ghulte-milte chhod doonga, un ki bari tadaad ki wajah se. Aur soor doosri baar phoonka jayega, phir Main un sab ko dobara zinda karoonga. Main un ki bikhri hui haddiyan aur un ka gosht jama karoonga, phir unhein hashr ke maidan mein le aaoonga.
100: Aur Main us din kafiron ke saamne Jahannam ko is tarah pesh karoonga ke us mein koi uljhan na hogi, aur woh use saaf dekh sakenge.
101: Main use un kafiron ke saamne pesh karoonga jo duniya mein Allah ki yaad se andhe the, us parde ki wajah se jis ne unhein us se roka, aur jo Allah ki aayatein sun kar maan nahin sakte the.
102: Phir kya jin logon ne Allah ka inkaar kiya unhon ne yeh samjha ke woh Mere bandon ko, yani farishton, rasoolon aur shaytanon ko, Mere siwa maabood bana lenge? Maine kafiron ke rehne ke liye Jahannam tayyar kar rakhi hai.
103: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: kya hum tumhein batayein, aey logo, ke apne aamaal mein sab se bade ghaate mein kaun log hain?
104: Woh log jo Qayamat ke din dekhenge ke jo koshish woh duniya mein karte the woh zaaya ho gayi, jab ke woh samajhte the ke woh apni koshish mein achha kar rahe hain aur yeh ke unhein apne aamaal se faida hoga. Haqeeqat is ke bilkul ulat thi.
105: Yeh woh log hain jo apne Rubb ki un nishaniyon ka inkaar karte hain jo Us ke yakta hone ko saabit karti hain, aur jo Us se milne ka inkaar karte hain, is liye un ke aamaal un ke jhutlane ki wajah se be-kaar ho gaye, aur Qayamat ke din Allah ke nazdeek un ki koi qeemat nahin hogi.
106: Woh badla jo un ke liye tayyar hai Jahannam hai, un ke Allah ko jhutlane aur Us ki utari hui aayaton aur Us ke rasoolon ka mazaaq udane ki wajah se.
107: Aur jo log Allah par iman laate hain aur neik kaam karte hain, un ke liye Jannat ke sab se buland baagh honge, un ki izzat ki jagah ke taur par.
108: Woh un mein hamesha rahenge aur wahan se hatna nahin chahenge, kyunke koi ajr us ke qareeb bhi nahin pahunchta.
109: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: mere Rubb ke kalme bahut hain. Agar samundar unhein likhne ke liye siyahi ban jaye, to samundar ka paani khatam ho jayega is se pehle ke Us ke kalme khatam hon, aur agar main us jaise aur samundar le aaoon to woh bhi khatam ho jayenge.
110: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: main to sirf tum hi jaisa ek insaan hoon, jis par wahi ki jati hai ke tumhara sachcha maabood ek hi maabood hai jis ka koi sharik nahin, yani Allah. Lihaza jo shaks apne Rubb se milne se darta hai use chahiye ke aise kaam kare jo shariat ke mutabiq hon, un mein apne Rubb ke liye khaalis rahe, aur apni ibadat mein apne Rubb ka koi sharik na thehraye.
